title: Check tire pressure
summary: Underinflated tires wear fast and feel vague in corners. Check them cold, once a week, before you ride.
tools: Air pump or a gas station air hose

steps.text: Check the tires cold, before riding or after the bike has stood for at least three hours.
Look up the front and rear pressure on your spec sheet. Use the passenger figure if you ride two-up or carry heavy cargo.
Remove the valve cap and press the gauge firmly onto the valve until the hissing stops, then read it.
Add air in short bursts and recheck until you reach the target. If you overshoot, press the valve core briefly to let some out.
Refit the valve caps. They keep dirt and water out of the valve.
While you are there, look for cuts, bulges, nails and tread below the wear bars.
steps.caution: A bulge or a cut that shows the cords means the tire must be replaced before you ride.
